hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qP "git\s+commit"; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); VALIDATE_SCRIPT="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/validate-version.sh"; if [ -f "$VALIDATE_SCRIPT" ]; then if ! bash "$VALIDATE_SCRIPT" > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[US-264 警告] 版號不一致！請先執行 bash scripts/validate-version.sh 修正版號後再 commit。"; fi; fi; fi'
